resources.string: This example requires an Internet connection!

Location permission is not granted. The app needs location access to show your position on the map and provide navigation. Please go to Settings -> Apps -> Bike Demo -> Permissions and enable Location.
Location service is turned off on your device. The app cannot determine your GPS position. Please go to Settings -> Location and turn on Location services.
This app requires location services to be enabled. Please enable location services in device settings and restart the app.

The token you provided was rejected. Make sure you provide the correct value, or if you do not have a token, visit magiclane.com, sign in or sign up, and generate one. Then input it in the AndroidManifest.xml file.

This example demonstrates how to display the current street / city names and speed limit information using the improved position data provided by the Magic Lane SDK. Use a mock location app or move outside on the streets to see the information displayed on the screen while following the position.
This example cannot run without location permission! Please grant the permission in app settings and restart the app.
